spikypanda-sim.description: Live SpikyPanda graph executor (browser-side). Requires `npm run server` and a connected nodeeditor-mcp.html (or research-project.html) page.

spikypanda-research.description: Persistent research store (filesystem). Root directory editable at runtime via the page UI; in-process provider hosted by `npm run server`.

spikypanda-projects.description: Research project lifecycle: create, define prerequisites and hypotheses, drive the matrix, record artifacts. The agent composes prerequisites from the project_list_check_kinds catalogue.
